rows.rule: Grid fit residual median≤0.5px; p95≤1px.
rows.meaning: Fresh dark image, after fitted H removes displacement. A statistical agreement proxy, not board displacement or final laser accuracy. Failure before controller open aborts launcher; during operation becomes optical hard fault.
rows.recommendation: CHANGE: current repair evaluates min(1px,.025cell) median/min(2px,.05cell) p95. Exact1762 repro shows inherited threshold unnecessarily rejects usable geometry. Keep independent support/identity checks; validate tail and target-local uncertainty.

rows.rule: ≥40 ORB matches, ≥35 inliers; ratio<.7, RANSAC2px; contained descriptors.
rows.meaning: Texture proposal generation. More matches are not independent clearance; 41 contained matches can generate unstable H.
rows.recommendation: INVESTIGATE: rank proposal quality/spatial spread rather than demand a costly denser fit solely to achieve pixel precision. Current-only bounded second fit is reasonable only when proposed geometry really remains insufficient.

rows.rule: ORB fit residual median≤1.5px/p90≤2.5px.
rows.meaning: Fit consistency against descriptor matches; empirical image-pixel gates. Can reject before grid validation.
rows.recommendation: INVESTIGATE cell/resolution scaling and robust held-out support. Do not lower descriptor match quality indiscriminately: grid aliases can satisfy repeated-texture fits.

rows.rule: ≥40 grid tracks, ≥6/quadrant, ≥3/outer edge; FB<1px; windows15/9px with10/7px support inset.
rows.meaning: Distributed geometry coverage, especially boundary movement/occlusion; numerical sampling footprints prevent outside pixels entering evidence.
rows.recommendation: KEEP coverage concept and complete footprint containment. Reassess absolute counts with board size/visible-region uncertainty; a few missing glare rails should prompt alternate real support, not guessed visible pixels.

rows.rule: Fitted reference-board corner movement≤25px.
rows.meaning: Bounds reference registration/requalification domain; not a measured mechanical damage limit. Correct H may compensate smaller movement already.
rows.recommendation: INVESTIGATE/REPLACE eventual cutoff with verified board identity, uncertainty and camera–laser relationship. Larger coherent movement can be recoverable, but image geometry alone cannot certify an independently bumped laser.

rows.rule: Native-vs-optical grid mismatch≤min(8px,.20×smallest spacing); spacing≥10px.
rows.meaning: Independent coordinate identity; protects wrong/shifted native grid. Uses maximum corner disagreement.
rows.recommendation: KEEP intersection-scaled identity gate for now; allocate jointly with aim/fit error and use actual local disagreement. Do not stack .20 identity+.20 aiming+.10 fit and claim a strict nearest-cell guarantee.

rows.rule: Frozen-anchor surviving tracks≥40 and≥85%; ≥6/quadrant; selected≤160 features.
rows.meaning: Dark-to-lit/current same-scene support; fixed denominator. Loss stops operation even when remaining spatial coverage could identify H.
rows.recommendation: INVESTIGATE over-conservative85% separately from needed coverage. Replace with sufficient distributed observable geometry where validated; no arbitrary denominator change to excuse hand/cover.

rows.rule: Frozen-anchor displacement median≤.5px/p95≤1px, before and after alias repair.
rows.meaning: Actual change relative to immutable image/H, unlike S01 fit residual. A median>.5 immediately rejects; p95-only may attempt correspondence repair.
rows.recommendation: CHANGE FAILURE HANDLING first: classify coherent small motion, go dark and independently re-register/reacquire. A cell-scaled reuse budget needs cumulative fixed-anchor uncertainty, not repeated chaining or simply copying S01 limits.

rows.rule: Native corner change≤2px against prepared native corners.
rows.meaning: Independent fixed-anchor invalidation; native detector itself suppresses jitter around2px at1080p.
rows.recommendation: HIGH-PRIORITY INVESTIGATE: near-equal tracker/update and host-invalidating thresholds can churn. Use coherent transformed agreement and bounded refresh; distinguish native-fit jitter from real movement.

rows.rule: One-row-inward64 probes:≥40,≥85%,≥6/side; median≤.5px/p95≤1px.
rows.meaning: Additional edge veto after interior tracking. Added to reject an independently shifted110px strip that interior-only proof missed.
rows.recommendation: KEEP independent edge evidence, EVALUATE precision and recovery. Preserve genuine partial-board warp rejection; a test expecting4px strip failure is not proof that every1px coherent shift must hard-fault.

rows.rule: Flow support radius56 half-pixels (112 full); local14 half-pixels; edge10 full pixels.
rows.meaning: Prevents pyramid/window/derivative/search stencils sampling outside printed-grid domain. Includes2 half-pixel engineering margin.
rows.recommendation: KEEP actual dependency containment. Optimize stencil/algorithm to reduce required inset rather than trimming containment blindly. Large inset contributes to support scarcity and inability to mask dot at pyramid2.

rows.rule: ≤32 suspect repairs; peak≥.8; competing-peak advantage≥.1; reverse≤.5 half-px; refinement≤1.5 half-px.
rows.meaning: Rejects full-intersection periodic-grid aliases; repair checks independent patches rather than deleting outliers.
rows.recommendation: KEEP alias-disambiguation requirement. INVESTIGATE signal-calibrated peak margins/number based on actual false matches and processing cost; an unresolved alias must not be treated as harmless pixel jitter.

rows.rule: Dot mask radius≤36px, halo12px,≤1% board area; spot/cluster center agreement≤8px.
rows.meaning: Optional masked renewal proof only; cannot replace mandatory unmasked proof or grant hand/stone clearance. Decline causes dark renewal.
rows.recommendation: INVESTIGATE local spot footprint/PSF scaling and broad glare. Fixed pixel mask is a conservative bounded default, not optical physics. Keep finite affected area and independent target visibility.

rows.rule: Three automatic reference fits must agree≤1px; changed reference grid≤8px.
rows.meaning: Dark reference renewal only after confirmed human position; rejects unstable snapshot without overwriting original model.
rows.recommendation: HIGH-PRIORITY CHANGE candidate: derive reference uncertainty in cell units/robust jointly fitted geometry; retry bounded fresh snapshots. Current1px fit-to-fit requirement can recreate S01 instability.

rows.rule: Final acquisition error≤.20cell.
rows.meaning: User-visible intersection indication objective; stops further refinement as soon as adequate.
rows.recommendation: KEEP as current product target; not hardware law. Evaluate user readability/worst-case total error before considering .25cell. Do not demand3px final accuracy for normal play.

rows.rule: Any held observation>.20cell immediately raises hard optical fault.
rows.meaning: Same boundary as acquisition, without hysteresis; no return to existing optical correction loop.
rows.recommendation: CHANGE: separate acquire/hold bands and bounded re-aim for fresh, unique, on-board spot. Start with shadow replay of .20→.25 hysteresis or uncertainty-aware band; retain immediate OFF for hand/unknown/corridor/pose problems. Do not present .25 as already validated.

rows.rule: Independent axis response gains0..2, plus5px unmodeled error and5px retained board clearance (10px envelope).
rows.meaning: Conditional motion-envelope assumption, explicitly not a physically certified motor-response bound. Covers either axis ordering.
rows.recommendation: KEEP containment objective; INVESTIGATE measured response uncertainty vs blunt0..2 and fixed5+5. Use local validated uncertainty and physical-wood boundary consistently, especially edges. Never treat interval mathematics as proof model physically correct.

rows.rule: Within90px of edge cap predicted travel40px; otherwise110px; up to20 shrink steps×.8.
rows.meaning: Speed/conservatism choice on top of same enclosure; no direct physical basis documented for90/40/110.
rows.recommendation: CHANGE candidate: distance-to-edge/error/uncertainty-scaled step selection. Keep enclosure, compare move counts/time and overshoot at edges. Shrink search exhaustion should offer smaller observed recovery, not erase calibration.

rows.rule: 45px fast/slow split; coarse motor cap[108,58], fine[18,10]; optical cap110px.
rows.meaning: Planner inherited from commissioning; pixels vary with view scale. Active feedback calls this step plan.
rows.recommendation: INVESTIGATE adaptive multi-speed/cell-scaled selection and independently measured deadband. Preserve firmware command spans/headroom; distinguish planner convenience limits from firmware maxima.

rows.rule: Lit fine corridor: moving axis±18 at setup/goal±6; held axis±12; requested fine step≤[18,10].
rows.meaning: Derived from firmware anchors, successive±6 permitted drift and goal-write ordering; actual worst-case corridor is larger than nominal motion.
rows.recommendation: KEEP until firmware/receipt semantics reduce uncertainty. Avoid relaxing because dot appears close; better synchronize/query actual anchor or change atomic command contract, then prove smaller bound.

rows.rule: Actual pose change after optical anchor≤3 counts.
rows.meaning: Maintains correspondence between observed dot and encoder pose before movement; exceeds this => hard fault. Firmware permits held drift±6.
rows.recommendation: HIGH-PRIORITY REPLACE hard stop with fresh stationary pose+spot reacquisition. Numeric3-count vs6-count mismatch is conservative, not arbitrary permission to use stale anchor. Quantify optical displacement per local Jacobian.

rows.rule: Startup actual pose within[8,5] counts of historical observed anchor.
rows.meaning: Limits safe initial illumination using saved spot; failure says setup fault although saved calibration need not be wrong.
rows.recommendation: CHANGE recovery: search/reacquire from fresh actual pose under safe dark/on-board constraints, preserve model. Keep check until replacement exists; hardware power-cycle settlement can legitimately exceed saved narrow envelope.

rows.rule: Host motor domain base1006..2894, tilt1906..2744; coarse span[1800,350], fine[24,12]; coarse waypoint[1794,344].
rows.meaning: Six-count inset/headroom relative to firmware bounds/spans; integer rounding checked.
rows.recommendation: KEEP paired protocol bound. Mechanical domain itself needs commissioning rationale, not routine runtime widening. The6-count headroom is derived from allowed firmware drift.

rows.rule: Predicted landing≥10px inside polygon; whole asynchronous model rectangle≥5px; exact target or inward.05/.10/.15cell proposals.
rows.meaning: Prediction guides dark acquisition; none is final optical acceptance. Absolute and observed-offset model envelopes both required.
rows.recommendation: KEEP optical acceptance independent. INVESTIGATE duplicated absolute/offset constraints after an observed bias; absolute model disagreement need not invalidate reliable local correction, but requires honest error bounds.

rows.rule: Interval proof≤511 boxes, depth12, width floor.01 motor counts;≤8 waypoints.
rows.meaning: Computational/finite-progress policy, not spatial safety law; failure declines predicted route and can use measured approach.
rows.recommendation: KEEP bounded work; optimize or subdivide travel on decline rather than hard-fault. Maintain distinction between no proof found and proof of unsafe route.

rows.rule: Response Jacobian condition≤15; smallest singular value≥.15px/count; supported motor hull / explicit extrapolation policy.
rows.meaning: Avoids ill-conditioned steering and uncontrolled model extrapolation; constants are engineering trust criteria.
rows.recommendation: INVESTIGATE dimensionless conditioning vs unit-sensitive.15 cutoff, learned local derivatives and uncertainty. Do not require dense calibration of361points; current model is a prior, fresh observations determine success.

rows.rule: Model kind affine, exactly3 samples, coefficients3×2/condition≤15, pinned dense derivative prior.
rows.meaning: Frozen experiment/binding schema; not a mathematical requirement that every useful model have exactly3points.
rows.recommendation: CHANGE architecture eventually: version capability/model policy; avoid treating provenance of this experiment as universal calibration requirement. Keep hashes/identity until explicit migration.

rows.rule: Spot pixels red>120/255, red increase>12 and red-minus-green increase>12; component area3..2000px; optional search radius100px.
rows.meaning: Laser/glint segmentation heuristic. Can miss dim spot or glare or clip predicted search; active first acquisition uses board-wide search.
rows.recommendation: INVESTIGATE exposure-adaptive/color/SNR thresholds and physical spot scale. Keep dark subtraction/competing-component checks. Do not increase search confidence by excluding alternative glints.

rows.rule: Cluster radius8px,≥5 members, competitor≥80% score and>8px separation rejects; newer component≥max(12,2×typical area) can reject.
rows.meaning: Spot identity/transition ambiguity protection; pixel scale and5-frame agreement are empirical.
rows.recommendation: INVESTIGATE scale-aware uncertainty and newest-frame actual spot confidence, with glint/hand negatives. Merely relaxing8px can merge distinct spots or conceal motion.

rows.rule: Optional inward waypoint if origin<2 or>16cells and target>2cells away; origin clamped to3..15; waypoint reached within.5cell.
rows.meaning: Route planning only, adequate target bypasses waypoint. Previously forced accepted K2 away; corrected already.
rows.recommendation: KEEP adequate-target early exit. Review any remaining waypoint requirement by measured route benefit rather than fixed ideal tour geometry.

rows.rule: Board9/13/19; four finite normalized corners; convex cross>.0005; doubled polygon area>.04; inverse determinant>1e−12.
rows.meaning: Input validity and minimum observable shape, not physical Go size constraints. Prevents degenerate transforms.
rows.recommendation: KEEP finite/convex/invertibility. Minimum apparent area/cross products need resolution/conditioning rationale for new cameras; not implicated in current failures.

rows.rule: Automatic rectangle confidence≥.4, aspect≥.35, size≥.25, quadrature35°; at most8 proposals.
rows.meaning: Setup candidate generator. Limits camera perspective/cropped boards; manual known geometry can use other paths.
rows.recommendation: INVESTIGATE for deployment; these are detector search defaults, not reasons to invalidate an established supported grid.

rows.rule: Native tracked motion<.4cell; pixel jitter threshold max(.75,shortSide/540), currently2px.
rows.meaning: Tracks native camera grid, retaining previous grid below jitter threshold; larger unsupported movement returns nil.
rows.recommendation: KEEP identity distinction; CHANGE recovery to explicit same-board requalification for larger coherent changes. Align jitter uncertainty with host2px invalidation (S09), avoid contradictory layers.

rows.rule: Accept correction only profile error drops≥20% and absolute>.008; retain old grid if error<.04.
rows.meaning: Preference/hysteresis for grid estimate, not true camera/board movement proof.
rows.recommendation: INVESTIGATE noise-calibrated update benefit; report uncertainty rather than switching between exact-old/exact-new at hidden thresholds.

rows.rule: Profile matching≥60% (fallback33%),≥8n matches,≥4n tests,≥3/outer rail,≥n/2/quadrant.
rows.meaning: Native alignment visibility. Current19board requires152 matches/76 tests/9per quadrant. Has caused false rejection of one edge despite stable board.
rows.recommendation: INVESTIGATE alternate support and glare-aware geometric inference with uncertainty. Retain independent visibility/hand evidence; inferred grid does not prove hidden cells empty.

rows.rule: Line depth>max(.012 faint/.035 ordinary,reference×.25),<reference×3; normalized profile error<min(.10,.03/depth).
rows.meaning: Photometric/shape proxies for grid match; local line probes allow bounded one-pixel jitter.
rows.recommendation: INVESTIGATE illumination/blur-calibrated likelihoods; not all brightness changes imply geometry change. Quantify false rejects by region, especially glare, before widening profile thresholds.

rows.rule: All four outer-line scores>.035;≥90% line scores supported; median>.07; pitch≥12 rectified pixels; positional max error<.16pitch.
rows.meaning: Initial grid fit/rail-sequence uniqueness. Search tolerance min6px,.22pitch; blank border extension check rejects additional regular lines.
rows.recommendation: KEEP topology/uniqueness; relax missing-line support through explicit inferred-rail confidence, not pretending all lines observed. Requirement is unique board coordinates, not90% visually perfect rails.

rows.rule: Known-position checks≥4n matches/tests and65%; stones≥80%; globally24/85% and quadrant6/80%; orientation advantage≥.025/.15.
rows.meaning: Occupied-board identity/orientation evidence, separate from empty-board initial detector.
rows.recommendation: KEEP nonambiguous orientation; INVESTIGATE joint grid+stone likelihood rather than independent vetoes. Weak stone model must not make clear grid unavailable unnecessarily.

rows.rule: Measured convex TL/TR/BR/BL wood outline; vertices in−2..size+1, edge length>1cell, encloses grid; exact camera/grid binding.
rows.meaning: Defines user-requested physical domain; required-profile mismatch becomes unknown rather than fallback to guessed rim.
rows.recommendation: KEEP. Outside-only motion must not be obstruction. Profile binding may be reprojected after verified coherent board movement; do not discard valid model because a profile needs fresh coordinate transform.

rows.rule: Wood projection finite, positive denominator>1e−8, entirely in frame;3×3 pixel patches partitioned by wood boundary.
rows.meaning: Prevents invalid/outside pixels masquerading as evidence; unknown if wood cannot be observed.
rows.recommendation: KEEP true visible support. Do not weaken for unseen edges; allow regional visibility policy only with target/path independently clear.

rows.rule: Vision≤4hands; joints confidence≥.25; each detected hand≥8joints to mark pose reliable.
rows.meaning: Hand detector quality proxy; unreliable pose becomes unknown. A person outsidewood may influence Vision reliability even without intrusion.
rows.recommendation: INVESTIGATE board-local relevance before global reliability veto and shallow-hand recall. Keep unknown if actual board entry cannot be excluded, but irrelevant exterior partial detections should not veto clear interior evidence.

rows.rule: Relevant hand samples>60% valid; outline component≥10 samples/≥9 raw cores; at least one interior raw core.
rows.meaning: Foreground connected-component evidence and actual wood penetration. Outside samples connect context but cannot alone establish entry.
rows.recommendation: KEEP interior-support principle. INVESTIGATE minimum component area vs shallow finger sampling; tune with real edge/corner hand datasets, not generic scene noise.

rows.rule: Crossing depth≥1/scale (scale10 =>.10cell) OR≥9interior samples; lateral distance<3.5cells; special≤.1cell/texture checks.
rows.meaning: Rejects edge artifacts and detects partial entry; a physical finger may enter less than one sampling unit.
rows.recommendation: INVESTIGATE target/path-local masks and resolution. Need recall for shallow entry and tiny target covers, plus outside-motion specificity; no blanket larger hand-area requirement.

rows.rule: Entry background preservation≥12samples, variance>.0001, correlation>.99, gain.6..1.4, residual/chroma≤.025.
rows.meaning: Accepts texture-preserving exposure/shadow as non-hand; these are current finite engineering thresholds, not calibrated probabilities.
rows.recommendation: INVESTIGATE wider nuisance distribution and shadow+finger controls. Adapt exposure before classification; do not infer clearance merely from equal mean brightness.

rows.rule: Foreground: |luminanceΔ|>.10 or chromaΔ>.035; directional chroma>.018; dark branch>.10; white exemptions light≥.65/chroma≤.12.
rows.meaning: Hand/foreground segmentation; unrelated board lighting can cause foreground.
rows.recommendation: HIGH-PRIORITY INVESTIGATE separate illumination vs occlusion, retaining spatial texture/visibility and target-local positive evidence. Generic lower sensitivity could miss fingers.

rows.rule: Background-preserving active component≥100 samples, texture corr>.98/.985; rim lightΔ≤.06/chroma≤.035 with≥50samples.
rows.meaning: Lets shadows/exterior pose clear without calling them hands; exact counts and residual gates may reject unchanged textured edge under new lighting.
rows.recommendation: INVESTIGATE learned/empirical camera noise and regional exposure model. Sufficient evidence should be physical-domain relevant, not a requirement to match exterior lighting.

rows.rule: White-stone hand exemption: fit≥.95 and occupancy≥.95; outer centered≤.20cell fit≥.90 and occupancy≥.99; verifies9neutral brightcore samples.
rows.meaning: Prevents hand detector mistaking real white stone for foreground, without masking a hand-shaped blob.
rows.recommendation: INVESTIGATE per-set/glare-aware stone evidence and small edge fits. Strict99% may drive false hand warnings, but replace by independently verified stone geometry rather than masking arbitrary bright patches.

rows.rule: Recognition difference threshold clamped.04.. .5; centered patch≥20samples/16wood; dark/light/unchanged votes≥.8.
rows.meaning: Heuristic appearance classifier; reported confidence is vote fraction, not calibrated probability.
rows.recommendation: INVESTIGATE per-camera/region noise and per-stone profiles. Never interpret0.8 as80% posterior. Keep uncertain state until enough local evidence, avoid making all361cells pristine prerequisite.

rows.rule: Lighting fallback blocks if empty<25% or uncertain>25% after appearance-only detection; >80% interstitial nearblack/white extreme exposure elsewhere.
rows.meaning: Visibility proxy can withhold frame and stop play. Empty percentage is sensitive to late-game occupancy, unlike actual visible support.
rows.recommendation: HIGH-PRIORITY INVESTIGATE separate visible-grid/stone evidence from empty count; densely occupied clear board is not inherently unreadable. Preserve real sensor saturation/opaque-cover rejection.

rows.rule: ≥24center/≥9outer samples; dark/light≥85%; gridcross requires both axes≥.5; local wood.15.. .96.
rows.meaning: Fallback/classifier geometric evidence. Fixed luminance range can exclude dim/glary valid wood.
rows.recommendation: INVESTIGATE sensor SNR and local normalized contrast. Stone/empty evidence needs bounded shape and visible grid, not identical reference brightness.

rows.rule: Ordinary disk radius(.32,.54)cell; masked≤.60; fitquality≥.78; contextual body≥65%, inside≥92%,visible≥50%.
rows.meaning: Stone footprint/ownership model; shape quality is empirical score, hard bounds can reject legitimate sizes/occlusion/parallax.
rows.recommendation: INVESTIGATE per-set radius/ellipse distributions and held-out size/edge tests. Preserve unique ownership, do not infer stone under occlusion merely from game history.

rows.rule: Assignment fits≥.86/.90/.94/.95 by branch, radius commonly.36.. .52; masked hypotheses can use.65 quality.
rows.meaning: Multiple nested quality vetoes; score changes may be discontinuous and not independently calibrated.
rows.recommendation: HIGH-PRIORITY consolidate evidence semantics/diagnostics; calibrate distributions by branch instead of lowering all scores. PG23 savedlaterframe fit.739 failed these gates but exact delayed pixels absent.

rows.rule: Ordinary ambiguous offset≥.30cell; unique-cover exemption fit/conf≥.94 and target inside−.08/neighbor outside+.08cell; nearest exemption≥.95 and advantage≥.10cell.
rows.meaning: Distinguishes off-center placement from ambiguous intersection. Fit search increments.04cell underlie.10margin.
rows.recommendation: KEEP unique-intersection objective; INVESTIGATE error-calibrated margin rather than fixed.30 as a centering demand. Off-center but uniquely assigned stone should play; optional centering must not become prerequisite.

rows.rule: Outward edge offset≤.46cell, strong fit/conf≥.90 and targetcovered; occupied-neighbor exception around.24cell.
rows.meaning: Recognizes no playable neighbor beyond board edge; current special-case rules already relax placement centering.
rows.recommendation: KEEP principle and test corners/partial coverage. Replace exceptions with uniform candidate-assignment reasoning once supported; no need to force inward centered placement.

rows.rule: Any uncertain/<.8 expected-empty8-neighbor makes new stone ambiguous, even strong central stone.
rows.meaning: Prevents between-intersection alias but ignores some already sufficient unique footprint evidence. Resets witness accumulation.
rows.recommendation: CHANGE targeted sufficient-evidence logic. Require a plausible competing assignment/extra stone rather than mere weak EMPTY; test genuine halfway stones, glare and captures. RetainedR16 delay is direct impact evidence.

rows.rule: Required readings confidence≥.8; unchanged verified-history reuse limited to max(12,n²/5)=72cells on19board.
rows.meaning: Board-state confirmation; positive new stones/removals cannot be inferred solely from history. More unknowns repeatedly reset confirmation.
rows.recommendation: INVESTIGATE region dependency/visibility rather than fixed20%unknown count. Keep new move/capture/contradiction evidence; history can constrain existing unchanged positions without claiming unseen cells observed.

rows.rule: Established stone fit/conf≥.90; radii.30.. .65; match shift≤.40cell.
rows.meaning: Maintains known stone identity despite small placement motion/parallax; helps avoid unnecessary relabeling.
rows.recommendation: KEEP concept; calibrate shape-specific association and coherent board movement. Do not make persistent history override clear contradictory new evidence.

rows.rule: White witness: second fit≤.02; locality≥.5known/.75new; score≥.92; strong ink branch quality≥.98,fit≤.005,grid≥.95,locality≥.9.
rows.meaning: Multi-cue white recovery under glare/shadow; weighted scores are evidence, not probabilities.
rows.recommendation: INVESTIGATE largest conjunctions and global score calibration; measure false negatives by stone/light condition. Keep distinction between known unchanged and new white.

rows.rule: ≥3stone samples across≥2rows/cols;≥75%support; logratioMAD<.035 and agreement with expected aspect±.045.
rows.meaning: Optional aspect/orientation inference, not required laser calibration or thickness estimate.
rows.recommendation: KEEP optional; not a reason to block play when unavailable. Passive parallax study remains unidentifiable without camera/placement assumptions; do not require physical thickness input.

rows.rule: Optional measured thickness>0mm; uncertainty0..value; optical candidates explicitlyuncalibrated.
rows.meaning: Data validation only; selected profile does not currently change recognition.
rows.recommendation: KEEP provenance/units. No gameplay spatial gate to loosen here; avoid promising automatic parallax correction from this metadata.

rows.rule: Calibration desired<3px; usable≤.25cell, unique footprint within±.5cell, footprint margin≥2px, unclippedsearch<98px.
rows.meaning: Endpoint quality grading already separates ideal measurement from usable intersection; finite calibration paths may still enforce stricter checkpoints.
rows.recommendation: KEEP desired vs usable explicit; default practical calibration should finish on usable evidence and report uncertainty. Do not let desired3px leak back into mandatory gameplay.

rows.rule: Local-vs-relative model disagreement<3px at endpoint; all absolute/local/relative predictions≥5pxinside.
rows.meaning: Commissioning steering trust check, distinct from final accuracy. Model disagreement can stop perfectly correct optical feedback. Not active gameplay endpoint routine.
rows.recommendation: CHANGE candidate: observed local response plus conservative spatial envelope, remeasure derivative on disagreement. Frozen model is prior, not truth. Keep containment until validated replacement; do not require models agree3px everywhere.

rows.rule: Entire motor-box local/relative model discrepancy<3px; margin≥5px; boxwidth≤256counts,≤32768boxes/depth18.
rows.meaning: Continuous enclosure proof for commissioning, not physical model validity. Can reject solely because two approximate models disagree.
rows.recommendation: INVESTIGATE collapse to one measured-response uncertainty envelope; classify proof-budget exhaustion separately from unsafe path. Avoid using mathematical interval precision as universal product requirement.

rows.rule: Calibration grid/reference movement<3px and repeatedboundary witnesses<3px.
rows.meaning: Fresh calibration guard; stale coordinate mapping stops run, checkpoints retained. Registration and hand visibility separate.
rows.recommendation: CHANGE recovery route: requalify coherent board motion, transform saved observations when camera–laser relationship unchanged and verified; otherwise remeasure small anchor set. No unconditional full tour restart.

rows.rule: Resume/probe comparisons<3px, pose within[8,5], motor probe singularvalue≥3counts; savednumeric coordinateagreement<.02px.
rows.meaning: Mixes model trust, motor observability and serialization consistency. Tight numeric equality is not claimed physical measurement accuracy.
rows.recommendation: KEEP numerical consistency checks; REASSESS physical/model3px as S62. Separate log integrity from noisy physical residuals to avoid misleading errors.

rows.rule: Savedcenter error<3px andwithin.15cell; restore endpoint discrepancy≤3px.
rows.meaning: Historical checkpoint admission policy for particular experiment. Not universal need for recentering before play.
rows.recommendation: DECOUPLE historical experiment acceptance from production requalification. Use actual observed anchor/model metadata without requiring repeat ideal center tour.

rows.rule: Firmware commissioned bounds base1000..2900/tilt1900..2750; monitor allows±3counts beyond; localmode1813..2280/2257..2417.
rows.meaning: Physical commissioned travel regions and distinct operating modes; source does not itself prove mechanical full-range safety.
rows.recommendation: KEEP installed bounds until physical/mechanical commissioning changes them. Do not widen to fix optical noise. Document hardware geometry/model units and which mode is active.

rows.rule: Dual tracked/held pose±6counts; local tracking±3/held±1; moving path min(start,target)−6..max+6.
rows.meaning: Measured motor drift/overshoot constraints underpin host envelopes. Exact6 is engineering policy, not shown manufacturer physicallimit.
rows.recommendation: KEEP coordinated bound now; investigate actual drift distribution/quantization and mechanical stability. Any changed bound must propagate hostcorridors, not one isolated constant.

rows.rule: Firmware singlemove spans: bench[1800,350], fast[24,12], corner[114,64], local[57,20]; coarsepair[1800,350].
rows.meaning: Protocol bounded actuation and commissioning profiles; host reduces spans for drift headroom.
rows.recommendation: KEEP finite movement/actualquery. Adaptive speeds within existing permitted profiles can improve time without widening spatial bounds; measure before changing physical span.

rows.rule: Quiet velocity±1unit, successive position±1count; fine deadband±3counts; unchanged≥4count command causesno_progress.
rows.meaning: Settling/deadband classification; not exact targetaccuracy because optics verifies result.
rows.recommendation: INVESTIGATE empirical quantization/vibration and unnecessary second recenter commands; allow stable-but-off-goal optical correction. Keep detection of actually moving/unresponsive joint.

rows.rule: Generic calibration register: ORB35; ECC/foreground fallback thresholds; median1.5/p902.5px,shift≤25px.
rows.meaning: Legacy/generic registration still used outside gameplay dark-fit admission; brightness veto repair in one path does not remove every other path.
rows.recommendation: MAP callers and unify explicitly named policies. Avoid accidentally reintroducing stricter generic path during calibration/recovery. Audit settings by active route, not same-sounding function name.

rows.rule: Hand timing extrapolation residual<.35cell,≥8consistentjoints; legacyrim±.75cell.
rows.meaning: Clock timestamp estimation only; should fall back to observed bracket, not grant motion/clearance.
rows.recommendation: KEEP fallback instead of blocking gameplay; ensure legacy timing rim is not reused as physical-wood laser obstruction boundary.

rows.rule: Residual percentiles computed only over valid surviving tracks; minimum40/quadrant6/edge3.
rows.meaning: Untracked local deformation can vanish from residual distribution while unaffected tracks pass. Owner controls local4px/32px image warps passed BOTH old/new policies with354/342 valid tracks; not all affected tracks are proven simply dropped.
rows.recommendation: HIGH-PRIORITY INVESTIGATE survivor-selection blindspot. Target-local expected-support/missing-track topology and independent local evidence matter more than tightening surviving residuals. Cannot claim every target accurate from p95. Separate pre-existing gap from current tolerance repair.

rows.rule: Optional provisional2-frame spot:area20..500px,cluster separation≤2.5px,area ratio≤2,competitor<1/3; correction≤[8,4]counts/12px.
rows.meaning: Early-correction experiment uses stronger spatial assumptions for fewer frames. Current bridge_feedback explicitly calls early=False; not active in current feedback gameplay.
rows.recommendation: KEEP route distinction. Evaluate as optional latency improvement using actual-newest-frame/glint tests; do not present it as an installed gameplay requirement or reason current test is slow.

rows.rule: Generic non-feedback path adequate≤10px; separate centering wiggle .12cell/max5px, advance≤3px.
